name: 30824 · Thomson, GA
findings: ZIP 30824 (Thomson) has 36 nonprofit organizations. 14 of them (39%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 10 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (54% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 30824 (Thomson) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 30824 (Thomson) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 70% of the typical level).
